name: Vkusny vinograd
source:
Max helped the girls quite a lot. But after receiving a reward for their joint efforts in the dining hall, he decided not to share it with anyone.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3047118347]Steam[/url]]
translation:
马克斯给了女孩们很多帮助。但在获得了他们在食堂共同努力的奖励后，他决定不与任何人分享。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3047118347]Steam[/url]]
